stories.label: Iran war Day 3+: Multi-front regional conflict — Lebanon, Iraq, Gulf, Cyprus
stories.summary: Day 3: War widened beyond Iran-Israel. Hezbollah fired first rockets since Nov 2024 ceasefire; Israel struck Beirut suburbs. Iraqi Shia militia hit US troops in Baghdad. Drone hit British base in Cyprus. Israel issued evacuation for 50+ Lebanese villages. School toll now 180. 3 US soldiers dead. Trump hiding at Mar-a-Lago.

stories.label: Khamenei killed: interim council active, Assembly of Experts still hasn't convened
stories.summary: Interim council (Arafi, president, chief justice) leading Iran. Assembly of Experts hasn't convened. Succession crisis ongoing amid active war.

stories.label: Iran school strike: death toll now 180+, war crimes evidence mounting
stories.summary: Death toll from school strike now 180 (MEE), up from 153. Israeli strike on Niloofar Square in Tehran killed 20+. Residential buildings hit. Numbers still climbing.

stories.label: Hormuz standstill + Gulf economic shutdown — UAE halts markets, airlines grounded
stories.summary: Hormuz still shut. UAE halted stock markets 2 days. Airlines grounded Gulf flights stranding thousands. Brent surging toward $90. Amazon data center in UAE hit.

stories.label: Most Americans oppose Iran war — Trump's own voters divided
stories.summary: Reuters/Ipsos: only 25% of Americans approve strikes. Many Trump voters opposed. Democrats fracturing — peace wing vs interventionist wing. War launched without congressional authorization, via 2:30 AM Truth Social video.

stories.label: Suspected insiders made $1.2M betting on Iran strikes via prediction markets
stories.summary: Suspected insiders made $1.2M on Polymarket betting on Iran strikes before announcement. Total war-related bets hit record $529M. No mechanism to detect insider trading on geopolitical violence.

stories.label: India's $60bn river storage plan threatens Pakistan's water supply
stories.summary: India investing $60bn in storage on Jhelum and Chenab rivers flowing into Pakistan. Wapda warns of increased flood/drought risks. Indus Waters Treaty (1960) under strain. Affects 200M+ downstream.

stories.label: DNA reveals one-directional Neanderthal-human interbreeding pattern
stories.summary: Ancient DNA reveals interbreeding was one-directional: Neanderthal fathers, human mothers. Implies asymmetric social structures between the two species.

stories.label: Selfish gene may bias sex ratio — Utah family has 2x boys
stories.summary: A Utah family produces twice as many boys as girls across generations. Researchers suspect a 'selfish' Y-chromosome gene biasing sex determination.

stories.label: Data centers racing to space — beyond national jurisdiction
stories.summary: Companies launching satellite-based data centers into orbit, beyond national regulation. Deepens digital dependency for developing world. Regulation hasn't caught up.

stories.label: Gaza sealed: all crossings closed, aid orgs halted under Iran war cover
stories.summary: All crossings sealed including Rafah. 37 aid orgs halted. Mosques shut during Ramadan. Collective punishment under Iran war cover.

stories.label: Pakistan erupts: 20+ killed in protests, Afghanistan retaliates with strikes
stories.summary: 20+ now dead in pro-Iran protests. Afghanistan retaliating against Pakistan strikes, claims hit Pakistani aircraft. Kabul-Islamabad border war escalating alongside domestic unrest.

stories.label: US intelligence shared Khamenei location with Israel
stories.summary: US disclosed Khamenei's location to Israel. May violate Executive Order 12333.

stories.label: Anthropic rejects Pentagon — but AI reportedly used in Iran strikes anyway
stories.summary: Anthropic rejected Pentagon demand. SCMP reports Pentagon used Anthropic AI in Iran strikes regardless. OpenAI backed Anthropic. Outcome of DPA threat unclear.

stories.label: Mass graves in eastern DRC after M23 withdrawal — accountability pending
stories.summary: Mass graves found near Uvira after M23 withdrawal. Rwanda hasn't responded. Investigation ongoing.

stories.label: Argentina: Milei passes reform, now pushing US 'strategic alliance'
stories.summary: Labor reform passed. Criminal age lowered to 14. Milei now pushing 'strategic alliance' with US as 'state policy.' Monthly reform packages planned.

stories.label: Kenya rolls out free HIV prevention injection
stories.summary: Kenya rolling out lenacapavir — twice-yearly HIV prevention injection, free of charge.

stories.label: Islamic State using AI to resurrect dead leaders
stories.summary: IS using generative AI to create synthetic media of dead leaders. Platforms failing to moderate.

stories.label: Syria three-front crisis — likely worsening as Iran war pulls attention
stories.summary: Syria fighting on three fronts. Iran war diverting international attention. IS likely exploiting vacuum.

stories.label: Myanmar junta bombing continues — obscured by Iran war
stories.summary: Military air strikes killed 17 at Rakhine village market. Further obscured by Iran war.

stories.label: Zimbabwe bans all raw mineral and lithium exports
stories.summary: Zimbabwe ban on raw minerals and lithium concentrate exports. Africa's largest lithium reserves.

stories.label: Sudan war — fading from global attention
stories.summary: Crisis continues. UNSC condemned RSF but no action. Iran war consuming all bandwidth. Needs coverage.

stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan border war escalating — Kabul retaliates
stories.summary: Afghanistan retaliating against Pakistan strikes, claiming to have hit Pakistani aircraft. Combat deaths in Pakistan up 30%. Three-way crisis: Iran fallout + Afghan border + domestic protests.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia war — missile strikes at 3-year peak, attention diverted
stories.summary: Russian strikes at 3-year peak in Feb. Attention fully diverted to Iran. Needs return next cycle.

stories.label: Sri Lanka arrests ex-intelligence chief over Easter bombings
stories.summary: Seven years of impunity broken.

stories.label: Sickle cell gene therapy — $2.2M cure inaccessible in Africa
stories.summary: Casgevy costs $2.2M. 80% of cases in sub-Saharan Africa.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — fading
stories.summary: Fading. Iran war reshaping trade dynamics.

stories.summary: One-time statement. Russia-NK-Iran alignment already tracked in iran-us-israel-war.

stories.summary: 6.5M Somalis face severe hunger. Al-Shabaab blocking aid. Not covered.

stories.summary: One-third of workforce cut, attributed to AI.
